lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty-two? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 22? Nope!

lines.text: Ann and Bo meet twelve kilometers from A, then turn back at the far towns.
lines.caption: Ann and Bo meet 12 kilometers from A, then turn back at the far towns.

lines.text: They meet again ten kilometers from A. How far apart are the towns?
lines.caption: They meet again 10 kilometers from A. How far apart are the towns?

lines.text: By the first meeting they cover one road, and Ann's part is twelve.
lines.caption: By the first meeting they cover one road, and Ann's part is 12.

lines.text: Then each walks the whole road, and both pieces back. THREE roads!
lines.caption: Then each walks the whole road, and both pieces back. 3 roads!

lines.text: Same speed, so she walks three times twelve. Thirty-six!
lines.caption: Same speed, so she walks 3 times 12. 36!

lines.text: That's the whole road, then the road minus ten.
lines.caption: That's the whole road, then the road minus 10.

lines.text: Two roads are forty-six, so one road is twenty-three!
lines.caption: 2 roads are 46, so one road is 23!

lines.text: Twenty-two was the trap. It just adds twelve and ten.
lines.caption: 22 was the trap. It just adds 12 and 10.

lines.text: Did you get twenty-three? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 23? Tell me below!
